senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; cmp. חָלָב, חֵלֶב , v. חִילְתִּית) galbanum, a gum-resin used as an ingredient of frank-incense, smelling like asafoetida.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 6b:66">Ib. 6ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 389:1">Yalk. Ex. 389</cite> <he>ח׳ ריחה רע ומנאה וכ׳</he> the smell of galb. is evil, and yet the Bible counts it among the spices (so are the wicked with the righteous combined in prayer).
